findings.evidence: `Polarized/Kinematics.lean:48` uses plain `public section` and supplies `_def`/`(rfl)` lemmas for the same purpose; all in-file proofs (`norm_num [probeOne]`, `kWit4_p := rfl`) are in the defining module and are unaffected by dropping `@[expose]`.
findings.fix: Replace `@[expose] public section` with `public section`, as in the sibling `Polarized/Kinematics.lean:48` and the two Mathematics files added by this PR; add `@[simp] spinUniquenessWit_vOne`-style accessors only if a consumer later needs the probe values.
findings.issue: `@[expose] public section` exposes the bodies of `spinStructureOne`, `spinStructureTwo`, `fromG1G2`, `IsG1G2Decomposition`, `ηWit` and `kWit4`, but every one of them already has its characteristic lemma (`spinStructureOne_apply` :96, `spinStructureTwo_apply` :106, `fromG1G2_apply` :198, `.eq` :270 plus `fromG1G2_isDecomposition` :259, `ηWit_apply` :382, `kWit4_p/q/S` :404-408). No consumer must unfold or compute, so exposure only lets downstream proofs depend on defeq of these definitions.

findings.evidence: `Tensors/Basic.lean:1035-1043` (`uniquenessWit`) inlines `vF1 := (0,0,1)` etc. with inline proofs and exports no probe defs or probe-value lemmas.
findings.fix: Mark the two probe defs and the four probe-value lemmas `private`, or inline the vectors into `spinUniquenessWit`'s fields with `by rw [spinStructureOne_apply, Matrix.detRowAlternating_fin_four]; norm_num` proofs, as `Tensors/Basic.lean:1035` does for `uniquenessWit`.
findings.issue: `probeOne` (:415), `probeTwo` (:418) and the four lemmas `spinStructureOne_probeOne_eq_one` (:421), `spinStructureTwo_probeOne_eq_zero` (:427), `spinStructureOne_probeTwo_eq_zero` (:433), `spinStructureTwo_probeTwo_eq_one` (:439) are public API with no use outside `spinUniquenessWit` (:446); `grep probeOne|probeTwo` matches only this file. They are scaffolding for one witness, and `probeOne : (Fin 4 → ℝ) × (Fin 4 → ℝ)` is meaningless to a consumer.

findings.evidence: Tensor.lean:465-466: `(by rw [kWit4_M2]; exact one_pos) (by rw [kWit4_p_q]; exact one_ne_zero)` — the manual rewrites are what the missing annotations cost.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` to `kWit4_M2` and `kWit4_p_q` (both are terminal rewrites to numerals, no loop risk). While there, use the repo's `:= (rfl)` idiom for `kWit4_p/q/S` instead of bare `rfl`, as in `Polarized/Kinematics.lean:87,90` and `Alternating/BilinMap.lean:56`.
findings.issue: `kWit4_M2` (:410) and `kWit4_p_q` (:412) are the closed-form values of the witness's `M²` and `p·q` but carry no `@[simp]`, while the neighbouring `kWit4_p/q/S` (:404-408) do; consequently `fromG1G2_kWit4_ne_zero` (:465) has to `rw` them by hand.

summary: Withdrawing the contested coefficient findings; the E₂ prefactor and the "standard form" docstring are internally consistent and the reverse/neg findings are fixed. Remaining: the new file exposes definition bodies it does not need, and the witness scaffolding (probe pairs and their four value lemmas) is public instead of private.
